title: Byte order helpers
description:
Write your own `htons`, `htonl` and readers for network byte order.

```
port 8080 -> bytes 1f 90
value 0x12345678 -> bytes 12 34 56 78
read back: 8080, 0x12345678
```
requirements: `void putU16(std::uint8_t* p, std::uint16_t v)` and `putU32`, big-endian (network order), with shifts.
Works the same on any machine; no casts of pointers.
